messages:
Maya Chen: Ugh — stuck with a 75min layover at SFO, any quick snack recs near terminals? Need something warm and fast, coming in T3 and leaving from T1C.
flight-bot: Automated: Flight AC852 arriving 13:42, connection time ~75m, gate T1C. Check terminal map: https://www.sfo.com/maps (eta updates in 10m).
Jonah Rivera: If you can make it to Terminal 3 food court, theres a little stall called BaoLab — warm bao, super quick line. :ok_hand:
Priya Patel: +1 BaoLab. Also Boudin sourdough bowls are quick if youre near the domestic side. Bread + soup > instant comfort. :bread:
Carlos Mendez: If youre international-side-adjacent, Humpty Slocombe ice cream is a mood but slow. For speed, the sushi-go place by T1 security is 5-min window grab (not great but warm rice).
Anika S: Pro tip: newsstand sells microwavable ramen cups and boiled eggs, haha. Cheap + zero line. Also bottled green tea = energy. :tea:
Maya Chen: Omg the ramen cup trick is so Redwood. Do terminals share same shops or am I doomed to hang by the gate?
Jonah Rivera: Depends on where you are after deplane. If you have TSA Pre, you can zip between T3 and T1 in ~12 min via the connector. Without Pre it's slower.
Priya Patel: If lines look long, grab a protein box from the coffee kiosk — salad + chicken, quick and not crazy messy.
Carlos Mendez: For something fast & hot: the dumpling window at Concourse C (near T1C) does express orders. They call your name in 3-6 mins.
Anika S: Vote: BaoLab vs Dumpling window? :meat_on_bone: :rice_ball:
Jonah Rivera: BaoLab (me)
Priya Patel: Dumplings (me)
Carlos Mendez: Dumplings
Maya Chen: Honestly anything warm. Putting my vote on dumplings.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — Ill sprint for the dumpling window if the line is sane. Catch yall on the other side of security. :running:
flight-bot: Reminder: Gate assignments can change. Double-check 15m before boarding.
Anika S: Safe sprint! Also tip: carry napkins. Airports are wild. :raised_hands:
Maya Chen: Youre the best. Will report back with hot take: dumpling > bao?
Jonah Rivera: Please deliver a verdict. :eyes:
